response.justification: Bogdan is a talented, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with strong experience in DLang, distributed micro-services, and infrastructure, but the role explicitly requires 8 years of C++ programming and deep cloud compute platform leadership, neither of which is demonstrated. His C++ exposure is limited to a brief ~6-month stint at National Instruments and a bachelor thesis project, far short of the 8-year minimum, and his career has been overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang web and product engineering rather than large-scale cloud compute platforms.
strengths: Extensive experience with distributed, high-throughput micro-services (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby) handling millions of requests/sec
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops) showing leadership and knowledge-sharing ability
Broad technical versatility across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure domains
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) versus the required 8 years
No demonstrated experience leading or architecting cloud compute platforms specifically
Career trajectory is generalist/full-stack rather than specialized infrastructure/compute technical leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform leadership experience
Strong distributed systems and mentoring background
